exposure: intrapartum fetal surveillance technique (ST analysis as an adjunct to cardiotocography (CTG) vs. CTG alone)
ST analysis (STan) as an adjunct to cardiotocography (CTG)
cohort: 207 women who participated in a previous randomized controlled trial comparing two techniques for intrapartum fetal surveillance
finding: There were no significant differences in postnatal psychosocial outcomes between women who received ST analysis as an adjunct to CTG and those who received CTG alone during labor.
